security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:

bundle.shortDescription: Logged-in browser sessions per site, for scripts and agents
bundle.longDescription: Spoor keeps one persistent browser profile per website. Log in once; scripts and agents then run inside that session through a local API. Recording captures traffic for figuring a site out.
